faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for KU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 1 December 2026, and candidates report at 10:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in KU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: 1 Senior Research Fellow, 2 Junior Research Fellow.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for KU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 1 December 2026 at 10:00 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. Where is the walk-in interview for this recruitment?
faq.answer: College of Fisheries Science, KU, Navsari.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is max 35 years for male and 40 years for female candidate. Relaxation: Female Max. 40 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs. 37,000 per month + HRA for 1st and 2nd year and Rs. 42,000 per month + HRA for 3rd year for Senior Research Fellow, Rs. 37,000 per month + HRA for 1st and 2nd year and Rs. 42,000 per month + HRA for 3rd year for Junior Research Fellow.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: SRF: M.F.Sc. in any Discipline of Fisheries Science. JRF: M.F.Sc. in the relevant subjects (Aquaculture/ Fisheries Resource Management/ Fish Genetics/ Biotechnology). The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. No TA/DA will be provided for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Written test to shortlist candidates if the number of candidates is more. Walk-in Interview. A written test will be conducted to shortlist candidates if the candidates are more.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Appointment purely on contractual basis. No employment provided after completion of the research scheme. Services of SRF and JRF may be terminated without any notice at any time by the University.
